rules.statement: The correct method of counting the four generations for a fideicommissum is from the first fidei commissary heir to legatee, and only the fifth fideicommissary heir can exercise free discretion in regard to the property.
rules.supporting_quote: "As to the method of counting the generations, in Holland and Friesland the general opinion of the Commentators has been accepted .... that it is not the first instituted or fiduciary heir who constitutes the first degree, and consequently only the fifth fideicommissary heir is able to exercise his free discretion in regard to the fideicommissary property"
